summary: Gap analysis identified two uncovered token lifecycle behaviors: revoked refresh token reuse prevention and access token introspection validity assertion.

scenarios.name: Revoked Refresh Token Cannot Be Reused
scenarios.objective: Verify that a revoked refresh token is rejected when used to generate a new access token
preconditions: Create a profile and capture profileId
Validate OTP and capture accessToken and refreshToken
steps: Attempt to use the revoked refresh token to call /token/refresh
scenarios.expected_result: The /token/refresh endpoint returns a 400 response and does not issue a new access token
scenarios.source_reference: Use Case1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx

scenarios.name: Introspected Access Token Returns Valid Status
scenarios.objective: Verify that a valid access token returns an active/introspected status when passed to /token/introspect
preconditions: Create a profile and capture profileId
scenarios.expected_result: The /token/introspect endpoint returns a 200 response confirming the access token is valid and active
scenarios.source_reference: Use Case1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx
